name: m2d-kit
description: Ready-to-use pieces for games on m2d: the stock cast (players, platforms, mobs, pickups, a turret, an NPC), scenery (a sky, stars and clouds, particle fields, ambient sound), genre controllers, prefab templates, combat effects and helpers — compositions of the engine's capabilities, too opinionated for the engine and too reusable to live in one game. Plain JavaScript; imports nothing from the DOM at load, so a server can import a game that imports it.
author: Mert Yildiz
